engineeringSkip.reason: Zero-point energy cannot be tapped as a net power source — the quantum vacuum's ground state is by definition the lowest energy state, so 'vacuum energy conductors' have no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Vacuum 'zero-point' energy is the lowest possible energy state of space, so it cannot be tapped to produce net power — doing so would violate thermodynamics, and no such material or device exists.
